mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO tunnel_runtime_status ( tunnel_id, cluster_id, gateway_id, session_id, host_connections, client_connections, channel_count, upload_bytes_per_second, download_bytes_per_second, reported_at, updated_at ) VALUES
( #{status.tunnelId}, #{status.clusterId}, #{status.gatewayId}, #{status.sessionId}, #{status.hostConnections}, #{status.clientConnections}, #{status.channelCount}, #{status.uploadBytesPerSecond}, #{status.downloadBytesPerSecond}, #{status.reportedAt}, #{status.updatedAt} )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE cluster_id = IF(VALUES(reported_at) >= reported_at, VALUES(cluster_id), cluster_id), gateway_id = IF(VALUES(reported_at) >= reported_at, VALUES(gateway_id), gateway_id), session_id = IF(VALUES(reported_at) >= reported_at, VALUES(session_id), session_id), host_connections = IF(VALUES(reported_at) >= reported_at, VALUES(host_connections), host_connections), client_connections = IF(VALUES(reported_at) >= reported_at, VALUES(client_connections), client_connections), channel_count = IF(VALUES(reported_at) >= reported_at, VALUES(channel_count), channel_count), upload_bytes_per_second = IF(VALUES(reported_at) >= reported_at, VALUES(upload_bytes_per_second), upload_bytes_per_second), download_bytes_per_second = IF(VALUES(reported_at) >= reported_at, VALUES(download_bytes_per_second), download_bytes_per_second), updated_at = IF(VALUES(reported_at) >= reported_at, VALUES(updated_at), updated_at), reported_at = GREATEST(reported_at, VALUES(reported_at))
